Gut Ecology and the Microbiome
The gastrointestinal tract has many functions in the health of 
an individual, and one of them is in immune integrity. This 
is because the largest immune organ is located within the 
gastrointestinal tract as gut-associated lymphoid tissue 
(GALT) and mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT) con-
taining innate and acquired immune systems as well as about
